items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with Tom for about -- oh, I guess two and a half years.

ctx.x: He wound up with the band here in San Francisco.

Yes, and I stayed with Tom for about -- oh, I guess two and a half years. And when I did leave him it was supposedly to start my own group. And I ran into so many roadblocks that I wound up joining another band because I couldn't stand the waiting around for something to happen. And so I joined Harry Sosnick's band, which was a radio band, and doing one of its earliest and first and only tours, I think. And that band, we had some very fine musicians, mostly from the Chicago area. And I think it was a good…

And I was growing a little bored with doing my show biz, once again. So I got this offer to go with Isham Jones, and the reason I got the offer was because about four or five guys in the band were friends of mine and knew what I could do musically, and got me the job with Isham.
